name: AdGuard Home
description: DNS server that blocks ads and trackers for every device on your network, with per-client rules, parental controls and encrypted upstreams (DoH/DoT).
compose:
services:
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.dns_port}}:53/udp"
    volumes:
      - ./work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    restart: unless-stopped
